fact: The evaluation of Mali numérique 2020 shows 27.30% overall execution (18 of 66 actions) and 24.24% resource mobilisation (54.5 of 224.792 billion), and a new policy and action plan Mali 2025-2029 was validated at a national workshop on 24 October 2024.
title: Économie numérique : Une nouvelle politique pour corriger les lacunes
